user.title: Connect to the Assist Decider server
user.description: Start the server first (see the README). The token is printed by `assist-decider gen-token`.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {url}
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the stored token. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Change the server
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL, that the server runs with --host 0.0.0.0, and the firewall.
error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.protocol_mismatch: The server and this integration speak different protocol versions. Update both to the same release.

data_description.threshold_en: Below this the request is not executed. Higher is safer, lower understands more.
data_description.threshold_de: German is less accurate than English, so the default is stricter.
data_description.memory_seconds: How long "turn it off" or "and the kitchen too" refers to the previous command. 0 turns follow-ups off.
data_description.fallback_agent: Optional. Requests Assist Decider cannot decide go here (for example Home Assistant or an LLM agent).

error.fallback_is_self: The fallback agent cannot be this agent.

protocol_mismatch.title: Assist Decider server needs an update
protocol_mismatch.description: The server at {url} does not speak protocol version {expected}. Install the same release of the server and the integration.
